decision_conditions: No works or development resulting in any change in the approved levels of the site in relation to the adjoining land and highway(s) shall be carried out without the prior permission, in writing, of the local planning authority.
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
The roof area of the garages hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.

Before the hard surfacing hereby permitted is brought into use the surfacing shall EITHER be constructed from porous materials, for example, gravel, permeable block paving or porous asphalt, OR provision shall be made to direct run-off water from the hard surfacing to a permeable or porous area or surface within the curtilage of the site.
Please note: guidance on permeable paving has now been published by the Environment Agency on http://www.communities.gov.uk/publications/planningandbuilding/pavingfrontgardens.

This permission shall have the effect of varying condition 2 on approved application reference PL/0707/23 dated 26/07/2024. The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents: PL-100 Rev B; PL-101 Rev B; PL-102 Rev B; PL-103 Rev B; PL-104 Rev B; 35 Charlton Road Cover Statement; 35 Charlton Road Garages Drainage Statement; 35 Charlton Road Garages Fire Strategy/Reasonable Exception Statement.

<p>The premises shall be used for the purpose specified on the application and for no other purpose, including any other purpose in Class C3 or C4 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any Statutory Instrument revoking and reenacting that order with or without modification).</p>

<p>The development hereby approved shall be carried out in accordance with the Fire Strategy/Reasonable Exception Statement as submitted (Ref. 35 Charlton Road Garages Fire Strategy/Reasonable Exception Statement).</p>

<p>The development hereby approved shall not be first occupied until works for the disposal of surface water have been provided on site in accordance with details to be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority. The works shall thereafter be retained.</p>
